impact: Strong Korean memory stocks and upbeat chip demand readings support MU, DRAM and SNXX after the early wobble, and keep the AI hardware trade intact into Nvidia's Nov 17 report.
summary: By midday Wednesday the Kospi was up about 1.7% near 5,330 and the KOSDAQ jumped 5%, with Samsung up about 2.4% and SK Hynix around 3%. The Nikkei rose about 0.8% near 60,940 for a third straight gain. The Reuters Tankan showed Japanese manufacturers' confidence at its highest in more than five years on booming chip demand, and CoreWeave's results lifted chipmakers despite hot US inflation.
title: Kospi up 1.7%, KOSDAQ +5% at midday as Tankan hits 5-year high
